content: {"episode_id":"ep-05002","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"Claim for mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was denied under CO-197 for lack of precertification prior to the service date. The clinical indication note states the patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation in the context of a personal history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction, consistent with diagnosis codes Z86.73, G45.9, and I48.91. The note documents the need to correlate these symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity to guide anticoagulation and rate control strategies, for which mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is ordered for extended ambulatory assessment. We ask SilverBridge to reconsider the CO-197 denial of the 701.94 balance based on this documented indication."}
